name: sitey.one
description: Free subdomain DNS service for developers. AI agents can instantly create A/CNAME/TXT records — no signup required. Supports Vercel/Netlify domain verification.

authentication.description: Anonymous: IP-based, 3 subdomains max. API key: unlimited.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List available root domains (e.g. sitey.one, sitey.my) that you can create subdomains under.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check if a specific subdomain name is available for registration under a given domain.

tools.name: create_subdomain
tools.description: Create a new DNS A or CNAME record for a subdomain. For example, create demo.sitey.one pointing to an IP address or hostname.

tools.name: create_txt_record
tools.description: Create or update a TXT record for domain verification (e.g. Vercel _vercel TXT token, Netlify verification).

tools.name: delete_txt_record
tools.description: Delete a TXT verification record from a subdomain.

tools.name: list_subdomains
tools.description: List all subdomains owned by the current user (identified by API key or IP address).

tools.name: update_subdomain
tools.description: Update the DNS record value of an existing subdomain you own (e.g. change the IP address).

tools.name: delete_subdomain
tools.description: Permanently delete a subdomain DNS record that you own.
